simple.meaning: קֹרֵא (qôrêʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “a caller , i.e. partridge (from its cry).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: קֹרֵא (H7124) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Samuel 26:20, with occurrences in 1 Samuel, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קֹרֵא (H7124) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in קֹרֵא (H7124) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: קֹרֵא (qôrêʼ) / H7124 is traced through 1 Samuel 26:20, Jeremiah 17:11 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H7124. qore I. קֹרֵא noun masculine Jer 17:11 . usually partridge (from calling ; see Gray in FFP 123 Post Hastings DB under the word Tristr Moab 129, 144 f. ; otherwise Bo Hieroz. Participle 2, 81 ff.; ed. Roseum. vol. ii. 632 ff. ); — 1Sam 26:20 ; Jer 17:11 , compare הִקּוֺ ׳עֵין Judg 15:19 .
